description: Creates a new task list and returns it (id, title, updated). The API accepts only a title — there are no other list-level settings. The returned id is the tasklist_id every task tool needs. Google caps the number of lists per account; a quota failure surfaces as an HTTP error, not silence.

title.description: The list title shown in Google Tasks (max 1024 chars).

name: create_tasklist
title: Create a task list
